Intel Registration Rejection
Please DO NOT reply to this e-mail message. This is an automated response.
Dear {!PRM_Registration_Request__c.PRM_First_Name__c} {!PRM_Registration_Request__c.PRM_Last_Name__c},
We appreciate your interest in Intel's Developer Zone, however, upon review of your application we regret to inform you that your request for a Premier Account has been declined. Reasons Intel may decline your request include:
Application does not meet the Developer Zone Premier program criteria, available in the Developer Zone Premier Terms & Conditions. Premier access to Intel's Developer Zone requires a Corporate Non-Disclosure Agreement (CNDA) between your company and Intel, or you are a party to the Intel® Partner Alliance Terms and Conditions. Developer Zone Premier access requires the account to have an active Intel Account Representative or be an active Intel Partner Alliance Member
You may continue to use your Standard account to access public content in the Developer Zone. Below please find a menu of valuable resources that have been enabled with your continued growth in mind, as well as details on how to register for Intel Partner Alliance to qualify for Premier access. To ensure that you continue receiving our e-mails, please add us to your address book. Additionally, we have several distributors and resellers that you may wish to engage with for resource help with your project.
How to Register for Intel Partner Alliance:
Join Now: https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/partner-alliance/overview.html Membership Requirements: https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/partner-alliance/membership/overview.html
Resources:
Intel Solutions Document Library: https://builders.intel.com/solutionslibrary For product and pricing related questions, please contact your Motherboard OEM, Intel Authorized Distributors (IAD) or Intel Authorized Supplier (IAS). You can locate a list of IAD or IAS at: https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/partner/where-to-buy/overview.html For product information: https://ark.intel.com/ Software & Drivers download center: https://downloadcenter.intel.com/ Intel Community: https://community.intel.com/ Intel Solutions Marketplace catalog: https://marketplace.intel.com/ Intel Customer Support: https://www.intel.com/support
Sincerely, Registration Administrator Developer Zone
*Disclaimer: Additional qualifications may apply. Not all requests are approved.
